decisions.finding: Initial Vav of ותחַת consists of a bare vertical stem terminating at row 1280, with 80 consecutive rows of pure white paper (rows 1282..1360, cols 1380..1410) beneath its baseline. There is no vowel mark (no Sheva, Hireq, or Patah). Confirmed unpointed consonant ו.

Medial Tav of ותחַת has its foot terminating cleanly at row 1324, followed by 36 consecutive rows of pure white paper (rows 1325..1360, cols 1310..1365) beneath its base. There is no vowel mark (no Patah, Qamats, or Sheva). Confirmed unpointed consonant ת.

Medial Kaf of הֲכינוֹתָ terminates its base foot at row 1322, with 38 consecutive rows of pure white paper (rows 1323..1360, cols 1040..1093) beneath its base. Precedes mater lectionis Yod. Confirmed unpointed consonant כ.
